Google TV bietet keine Auswahl für den S:
Google TV offers no choice of home screen. Two ways:
1. Redirect the Home button: turn on “Glas Launcher” in the accessibility settings. If a “Restricted setting” message appears, first choose Apps → Glas Launcher → ⋮ “Allow restricted settings”.
2. Turn off the Google interface (most reliable), on a computer:
adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Damit der Glas-Bildschirmschoner auch in:
To show the Glas screensaver in other apps too, on a computer:
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_components de.glas.launcher/.ClockDream

Freigeben beendet Apps, die im Hintergru: Freeing up ends apps resting in the background (e.g. YouTube after you return). They start a little slower the next time you open them. Android also cleans up memory by itself; freeing up helps mainly when an app stutters or crashes. Running system services are not affected.
